## 简体中文

Sempre 2.0.3 将流量历史采集移入 Sempre 守护进程，新增按账单周期保留的控制，改进首次运行时的配置激活，并明确控制 UI 中网络探测耗时的含义。

### 后台流量历史

- 守护进程持续采集各标签的下载和上传总量，无需保持流量页面打开。
- 流量历史保存在 Sempre 后端状态而非浏览器 IndexedDB 中，因此更换浏览器后仍会保留，并可由经过认证的控制客户端共享。
- 按分钟聚合历史，并提供设备、用户、主机、出口和进程维度的总量。
- 通过原子写入和优先清理最旧数据桶限制采集与存储规模。

### 账单周期与保留策略

- 新增滚动窗口和按月账单周期的历史策略。
- 支持配置每月 1 至 31 日重置；月份天数不足时使用当月最后一天。
- 默认最多保留 12 个账单周期；启用存储限制时可配置周期数量或选择不限周期。
- 所有历史共用一个存储上限，达到上限时优先淘汰最旧的分钟数据桶。
- 在控制 UI 中明确标注历史周期、滚动窗口长度、保留账单周期和历史总存储上限。

### 运行与诊断

- 初始化时激活默认本地订阅配置，允许“启动”准备缺失配置；没有代理节点时也能生成有效的纯直连 sing-box 配置。
- 将网络探测计时标注为请求耗时而非延迟，因为测量包含 DNS、连接、TLS 和服务器响应时间。

### 安装或升级

- macOS 和 Linux：运行 `curl -fsSL https://sempre.run/install | sh`。
- Windows：从下方资产下载匹配的 Release bundle。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.2...v2.0.3)

## English

### Sempre 2.0.3

Sempre 2.0.3 moves traffic history collection into the Sempre daemon, adds billing-cycle-aware retention controls, improves first-run profile activation, and clarifies network probe timing in the control UI.

### Background traffic history

- Collects per-tag download and upload totals continuously in the daemon, without requiring the Traffic page to be open.
- Persists traffic history in the Sempre backend state instead of browser IndexedDB, so history survives browser changes and is shared by authenticated control clients.
- Aggregates history into minute buckets and exposes totals for device, user, host, outbound, and process dimensions.
- Keeps collection and persistence bounded, with atomic writes and oldest-bucket-first cleanup.

### Billing cycles and retention

- Adds rolling-window and monthly billing-cycle history policies.
- Supports a configurable monthly reset day from 1 through 31; short months use their last valid day.
- Retains up to 12 billing cycles by default, with configurable cycle count and an Unlimited option when a storage limit remains enabled.
- Applies one total storage limit across all retained history, evicting the oldest minute buckets first when that limit is reached.
- Clarifies the control UI with explicit labels for the history period, rolling-window length, retained billing cycles, and total history storage limit.

### Runtime and diagnostics

- Activates the default local subscription profile during initialization and allows Start to prepare its missing configuration, including a valid direct-only sing-box configuration when no proxy nodes exist.
- Labels network probe timing as request duration rather than latency, reflecting that the measurement includes DNS, connection, TLS, and server response time.

### Install or upgrade

macOS and Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://sempre.run/install | sh
```

Windows users can download the matching release bundle from the assets below.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.2...v2.0.3
